Tomas places two covers beside the gauge. One is a foldout for any workshop: measurements are starting points and a warning box travels beside the drawing. The other is a set of local pages held by each forge, so changes can be reviewed by people using that material and weather. The first may spread a method quickly, but a copied diagram can lose its conditions. The second allows close revision, but a traveler may not know where to request a copy. Rowan records that distribution and maintenance are separate questions. A pattern can be open while its assumptions remain visible; a local page can be shared without making contributors surrender control of their names.

Supplemental atlas workshop note —Supplemental atlas workshop note — distribution comes with work after printing

Tomas asks Rowan who will answer a letter from a distant forge if the open foldout is copied without its newest correction. Nia offers to maintain a dated correction list, but only while the community continues to fund the paper and courier runs. Mara points out that local pages also need a keeper; a small workshop may close or lose its binder. The two options therefore carry different kinds of work, not one public and one private virtue. Rowan records who volunteered for the first review period and leaves the later periods open. People may revise the arrangement if maintaining either route becomes a burden they cannot carry.

entries.title: A Foldout that Carries Its Limits
entries.body:
The open edition puts warnings beside every measurement. Rowan includes the dry-ground Ashfall cart trial, Ruth's salt-wind schedule and Mara's removable graft tie as separate examples rather than one combined rule. Each page names its place and leaves a route for corrections. A copy may be made without Tomas's permission, but it must preserve the condition box and edition date. Nia adds a blank revision strip so another workshop can record a tested variation without pretending it existed in the first printing.

Supplemental atlas workshop note —Supplemental atlas workshop note — copy the warning in the same hand's reach

The foldout is printed on a larger sheet than the first trial copy so the warning box stays beside the jaw diagram when the page is folded. A maker should not have to unfold a separate appendix to learn that a fracture invalidates the reading. Gideon tests a copy in the cart kit and finds that rain smears the graphite revision strip. Nia changes the strip to ink and reserves a space for a later edition stamp. The open copy can travel widely, but only if its conditions survive the trip. Reproduction permission does not make a damaged or incomplete copy an approved repair.

entries.title: A Lesson with Two Readings
entries.body:
Tomas demonstrates the gauge to two cadets. The first places it against a flat hinge; the second repeats the fit after turning the hinge over. Their readings differ because the back plate is worn. The lesson is not that one cadet used the tool incorrectly. They document its orientation and ask whether the hinge should be replaced or watched. Tomas adds the method to the open foldout and invites the cadets to leave a dated correction when another part behaves differently.

Supplemental atlas workshop note —Supplemental atlas workshop note — disagreement can be the first lesson

After the cadets find different readings on the hinge, one asks which of them should teach the gauge. Tomas gives each a clean plate and asks them to describe the surface before taking a measurement. Their methods converge on the flat side and separate again at the worn back. Neither cadet is dismissed. They write a short correction explaining that the tool needs a stable edge. The lesson goes into the next open edition with the original example. Tomas wants young smiths to learn that uncertainty can be a property of the object or method, rather than a failure they must hide from a master.

entries.title: A Copy Sent with a Means to Revise
entries.body:
Gideon checks the public pattern against the cart. The conditions remain attached: empty load, dry ground, short test and named repair pin. He sends one copy with the kit and keeps another by the village tools. The guide does not certify the cart for a storm. It supplies a repeatable starting point and a visible place for new trials. Gideon asks copyists to keep the edition date and correction address so an old drawing can be challenged rather than silently treated as current.

Supplemental atlas workshop note —Supplemental atlas workshop note — Gideon's kit needs a return path for old copies

Gideon takes the foldout with the repair kit and pins a card inside the cart shed naming the edition date. He asks that anyone who finds an older sheet return it to the shed or add its date to the correction envelope. The drawings may remain useful, but a superseded instruction should not circulate as if it were current. Rowan writes a simple notice that does not require a person's name. Gideon wants neighbors to challenge a bad fit without fearing they will be blamed for following the page. The public method is open to use and open to correction.

entries.title: A Margin for Local Practice
entries.body:
The local edition binds blank pages after each tested pattern. A workshop may note iron source, wood age, wind exposure and the next inspection date. Names are optional; method and revision date are not. Nia numbers each page so corrections can be matched without attaching a household to the repair. The format encourages useful sharing while leaving room for local materials. It does not promise every forge has the same supply or the same person available to maintain the tool.

Supplemental atlas workshop note —Supplemental atlas workshop note — return the local binder before leaving the forge

The local binder stays on the forge's dry shelf. A visiting maker may borrow a tracing, but the original page remains there so revisions do not split across copies. Tomas adds a checkout card for the tracing, not for the borrower's identity unless they choose to include it. At the end of the work, the sheet goes back into its numbered sleeve. The arrangement helps this forge keep a shared history; a neighboring shop may prefer to keep its own copy. Nia writes that local custody is a decision of the workshop, not a rule Tomas can impose on all of them.

entries.title: The Maker Who Changes the Pattern
entries.body:
Tomas remembers finding a jaw gauge altered by his first master. He believed the change criticized his measurements until he found the attached note: the original jaw had scored a softer hinge after a wet winter. The master left Tomas a reason, not only a different notch. Tomas keeps the screw free and asks future smiths to record their material and conditions. The local edition treats revision as part of the craft, not proof that the first maker failed.

Supplemental atlas workshop note —Supplemental atlas workshop note — explain why the master changed the jaw

Tomas finds the old note folded beneath the altered gauge: the softer hinges had begun to show a crescent mark after the winter rain. His master changed the jaw to spread the contact, then kept the earlier version beside it for comparison. Tomas realizes that the notch was not an accusation but a record of material meeting weather. He copies the explanation into the local binder, including that the old jaw remains available for a controlled bench test. A later maker can decide whether the same change fits their metal. The story does not turn one master's fix into a rule for every shop.

entries.title: Review Date without a Roll of Names
entries.body:
Nia writes the next review season on the cover and puts a correction envelope beside the pages. A maker can add a name, a workshop mark or no attribution. The method remains traceable because each entry names material and place; the person decides whether their identity travels with it. Nia refuses to create another roll that might be mistaken for consent to every future use. The local copy records an invitation to review, not permanent approval on behalf of its contributors.

Supplemental atlas workshop note —Supplemental atlas workshop note — review without turning the cover into a roster

When the review season arrives, Nia places a blank card by the forge door for comments about the gauge. Some makers mark the page number; others leave a question without signing it. Nia responds on a separate sheet and pins it beside the binder rather than filling the contributor list. The workshop can tell which instruction needs review without keeping a permanent record of who raised it. If a correction requires direct follow-up, the person may leave a private contact in a sealed envelope. The review date opens a chance to revise the method; it does not renew consent to publish anyone's name.

entries.title: The Measure That Leaves Room
entries.body:
Tomas reads the final pages without closing the book over its margin. The notes carry examples from Ashfall's dry road, Salt Road's grit, Cinderwell's water, Greenwake's living stems, the Choir's resonant rooms and Outer-Wake's uneven surfaces. None is declared the best. Each page names its object, tool, conditions and a route for another measurement. The atlas works because a reader may begin without pretending the first mark settles every future repair.

The open foldout keeps warnings beside diagrams and leaves a return address for corrections. The local pages give each forge room to record materials and review dates; contributors' names remain optional. Either edition can be copied, challenged and replaced. The records preserve what was tried, not a permanent claim over the hands that will use the tool.

Rowan leaves the last line empty. It is not waiting for a final standard. It is a place for the next repairer to say what changed: a storm, a new material, a different load, or a surface that no longer holds still. Tomas adds one sentence beneath it: 'Measure again before you promise.'

Supplemental atlas workshop note —Supplemental atlas workshop note — leave the last line for the next material

Tomas closes the book only long enough to tie the loose sheets together. On the cover he writes the six places where the gauge was tried and the limits recorded at each. He leaves the seventh line blank because no one has yet tested it against winter ice or a moving bridge. The blank is not a promised destination; a future craftsperson can use it for a question that matters to their work. Rowan asks if the atlas is finished. Tomas says the first edition is finished, while the practice of checking a repair belongs to whoever chooses to use it. The book can offer a method without owning the next decision.

entries.title: Pella Quinn trở lại Greenwake
entries.body:
Pella Quinn từng phụ cha dựng các bờ đá quanh vườn rễ. Sau một trận mưa, đoạn tường phía đông nứt ra và cô ghi ngắn gọn rằng đá đã hỏng. Pella rời Greenwake trước khi có đợt khảo sát tiếp theo; nhiều năm sau, Mara tìm được rễ cây đã trườn qua mặt trong của móng. Pella không biết rễ có làm lệch bức tường hay chỉ đi theo khe có sẵn. Cô trở lại để sửa hồ sơ cùng cấu trúc, nhưng sẽ không thay một phán đoán cũ bằng một phán đoán mới khi chưa có phép đo lặp lại.

Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note —Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note — return to the line she left behind

Pella reads her old sentence beside the repaired patch and recognizes the quick, square letters she used before leaving. She does not cross out “the stone failed.” Instead, she adds the date of her return, the position of the loose block, and a note that the old page was written before anyone measured the footing. Her father taught her to set a wall by eye, but he also taught her to leave a mark another mason could check. She remembers the lesson clearly; she cannot make it a measurement after the fact. Rowan places a fresh blank sheet next to the old entry, so the repair can begin without pretending the earlier record said more than it did.

entries.title: Móng đông: hai mặt khác nhau
entries.body:
Bản khảo sát ghi mặt ngoài của bức tường còn phẳng trong khi lớp đất phía trong đã lún. Một khoảng hở dưới viên đá thứ ba thay đổi theo vị trí, nhưng người đo cũ không đánh dấu điểm đặt thước. Rowan đo từ cùng một mốc đá, giữ khoảng hở lớn nhất và nhỏ nhất cạnh nhau. Các số này mô tả một mặt móng vào ngày khảo sát; chúng không xác định nước, rễ hay sức nén của đất là nguyên nhân chính. Nếu lần đo kế tiếp dùng mốc khác, hai dãy số sẽ không thể so sánh.

Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note —Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note — renew the chalk datum

The original chalk mark has weathered down to a grey fleck. Pella chooses the corner of a fixed stone that remains above the soil line and asks Rowan to photograph it beside the ruler before drawing a new mark. They write the old reference and the new one on separate cards. If the stone shifts, the next crew will know that their measurements no longer share a starting point. The two gaps are not averaged into a cleaner number. One belongs to an earlier survey with an uncertain ruler position; the other belongs to this visit. Pella says that a careful difference can be more useful than a smooth-looking answer.

entries.title: Mặt gãy không phải lời khai
entries.body:
Viên đá được tìm thấy úp mặt vữa xuống lớp đất ẩm. Một phần bột nằm phía trong tường, song dòng nước mưa có thể mang nó qua khe sau khi viên đá rời vị trí. Không còn ảnh chụp hiện trường trước khi dọn vườn, nên Pella không thể khôi phục chính xác hướng rơi. Rowan lưu mặt gãy, chiều của viên đá và tình trạng đất lúc tìm thấy. Ghi chú không gọi đây là dấu tay, dấu rễ hay bằng chứng phá hoại; cả ba giả thuyết đều cần dữ liệu khác.

Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note —Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note — keep the moved stone's position visible

The block has already been lifted from the damp earth, so a sketch made now cannot restore its exact place before the garden was cleared. Rowan draws the face that was down and the side that held the loose mortar, then notes which edge was handled first. Pella asks the crew to keep the stone on a timber rest rather than set it upright for a better view. The rest prevents fresh scuffing but does not recover the missing scene. When the block returns to the wall, its new position will be recorded as a repair choice, distinct from whatever position it occupied when it fell.

entries.title: Sổ tưới và khoảng trống dưới đá
entries.body:
Mara giữ lịch tưới qua nhiều vụ, nhưng các dấu chỉ ngày và thời lượng. Bản đồ rễ được vẽ sau khi tường nứt, nên không cho biết cây đã phát triển theo khe nào trước đó. Mara nói có thể kiểm tra những rễ còn sống trong luống hiện tại, song không thể dùng chúng làm đại diện cho cây của mùa cũ. Cô cũng nhắc Rowan rằng một lịch tưới đúng không đồng nghĩa phép đo tường đúng. Hai sổ cần được đặt cạnh nhau với phạm vi riêng, thay vì để một loại dữ liệu lấp khoảng trống của loại kia.

Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note —Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note — the blank seasons stay blank

Mara lays the watering book open across two seasons where the ink stops. She remembers that the garden crew was short-handed, but she will not fill the empty dates from a memory that could belong to a neighboring bed. Pella asks whether they should mark those pages as missing. Mara prefers “no surviving entry,” because the book may have been stored elsewhere rather than never written. Rowan adds the phrase to the index without squeezing it into the watering table. They can start a complete schedule now, but it will describe a new period. A full present record cannot tell them what happened during the absent seasons.

entries.title: Một lứa cây trong một luống
entries.body:
Lứa Glassplum này được trồng ở mép luống phía đông, cách bức tường một sải tay. Lịch thu hoạch và vị trí gieo được ghi cạnh nhau để lần sau có thể lặp phép đo. Cây sống qua một chu kỳ hoạt động trong điều kiện tưới hiện tại; kết quả không cho biết rễ đã đi tới độ sâu nào dưới móng. Mara giữ nguyên phần rễ còn lại trong đất để không biến một mẫu nhỏ thành toàn bộ cây. Pella dùng một nhánh đã cắt tỉa làm thước so sánh mềm, không dùng nó để đẩy đá trở lại vị trí.

Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note —Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note — leave room beside the east bed

The first row sits close enough to the stones that its gardener has to turn sideways to reach the inner plants. Mara shows Pella where a wide basket catches on the wall and where a smaller hand tray passes without brushing the new shoots. They mark both paths on the plot card, then ask the next shift which route is comfortable to use. The test bed keeps its position for comparison, while access to it can still be improved. Pella does not count a harvest as a success if tending the row requires someone to hurt their shoulder or tread on the neighboring plants. That concern belongs to the garden plan, even though it cannot explain the older crack.

entries.title: Hai vòng không tạo thành niên đại
entries.body:
Hai vòng tăng trưởng cho thấy nhánh gần tường rộng hơn nhánh phía đầu luống. Thời điểm cắt không trùng nhau; khoảng cách giữa các vòng cũng bị một vết cọ làm mờ. Pella muốn dùng số đo để khoanh khu vực cần xem lại, nhưng không đủ dữ kiện để gọi một vòng là năm tường nứt. Rowan đặt thước trên cả hai nhánh cùng một chiều và ghi vùng sai số bằng nét đôi. Năm sau, người làm vườn có thể lặp lại việc đo ở đúng hai vị trí hoặc chọn mẫu mới nếu cây đã đổi hướng.

Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note —Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note — check the cutting tool before comparing rings

One branch was trimmed with Mara's narrow pruning knife and the other with an older saw. The cut edges differ, and a shallow nick makes the outer ring harder to follow on the second sample. Pella marks the uncertain arc instead of tracing through it. Rowan measures the same visible radius twice and records which tool made each cut. The growth bands may help choose where to inspect a living root next, but they do not supply dates for the wall. Before another comparison, Mara wants both branches cut with the same cleaned tool and laid in the same orientation. A similar-looking ring is not a calendar unless the method gives it one.

entries.title: Vine Stalker trong khe tường
entries.body:
Vine Stalker xuất hiện từ một hốc dưới luống, nơi đất đã rời khỏi chân móng. Rowan dọn con đường hẹp để Pella có thể quan sát lớp đá bên trong. Con quái có thể đã mở rộng khe, tìm tới một khe cũ hoặc chỉ trú ở đó sau khi đất trôi; không có dấu vết nào phân biệt được ba khả năng. Pella thu một bó sợi nâu mắc trên cạnh đá làm vật liệu thử. Cô yêu cầu không dùng bó sợi ấy để kết luận loài này gây ra mọi vết nứt ở Greenwake.

Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note —Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note — draw the passage before closing it

After the Vine Stalker is gone, loose earth begins to slide into the narrow passage. Rowan places a board beneath the edge so Pella can finish the sketch without leaning against the wall. They draw the creature's route through the soil as it looks now, not as it might have looked before the fight. Mara asks that the opening stay visible until a gardener checks whether small animals still use it. The repair crew can protect the footing without sealing every living gap. Pella writes that the encounter changed the site before their final inspection. The note prevents a later reader from mistaking this cleared tunnel for an untouched view of the old crack.

entries.title: Mẫu sợi, không phải dấu thủ phạm
entries.body:
Một đoạn sợi thực vật nâu còn mắc trên cạnh đá sau khi Vine Stalker bị đánh bại. Đầu sợi tưa, nhưng đất quanh đó đã bị khuấy lên trong trận. Rowan giữ một phần sạch cho phép thử vật liệu và để phần bẩn trong khay tách biệt. Hai mẫu có thể giúp người thợ kiểm tra độ bám của lớp keo; chúng không xác định thời điểm khe mở hoặc sinh vật nào đã đi qua. Pella ghi cả việc hốc vừa bị xáo trộn để người xem sau biết giới hạn của mẫu.

Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note —Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note — two sleeves for two kinds of dirt

The clean fiber and the soil-stained fiber travel in separate sleeves, each with the finder, place and collection time. Rowan notices that a few strands from the clean sample have caught on the outside of the second sleeve. Talia tells him not to brush them back inside; once the packages touch, the second sleeve is relabeled as a handling sample. Pella accepts that the usable piece has become smaller. A tiny material test with a known source is more useful than a larger sample whose path is uncertain. The fiber may inform the removable resin trial. It cannot establish when the wall opened or which living thing first passed through it.

entries.title: Talia đặt giới hạn cho mẫu đá
entries.body:
Talia không gọi vệt nâu là gỉ chỉ bằng mắt. Bùn, oxit sắt hoặc nhiều lớp vật liệu có thể tạo màu tương tự; cần tách một mẫu nhỏ và ghi cách làm sạch. Cô đưa Pella một viên đối chứng đã đánh dấu nhưng không lấy mẫu từ giữa dòng nước đang dùng. Phép thử giúp thợ rèn biết lớp keo bám lên đá đã rửa như thế nào. Nó không đo chất lượng nước, nồng độ khoáng trong toàn basin hay độ bền của bức tường qua mùa mưa.

Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note —Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note — wash one face and preserve the other

Talia draws a line through the middle of the comparison stone, then washes only one side with clean water from a labeled vessel. The other side stays as found. She weighs the stone before and after drying both faces and records how long it sat under the same roof. Pella can compare adhesion on two surfaces without calling either one representative of the entire garden. Talia keeps the rinse water in a jar because the test has added material to it. Nothing from that jar returns to the basin. The small procedure answers a question about this stone and this resin mixture; it does not replace a water inspection by the people responsible for the channel.

entries.title: Một bậc đá từ nơi khác
entries.body:
Viên đá lưu tại Cinderwell được cắt thành bậc thoát nước, không phải khối chịu lực của một tường vườn. Vết đục chạy cùng thớ và cạnh dưới sẫm màu sau nhiều lần ướt. Pella dùng nó để xem thợ cũ xử lý mép đá, chứ không sao chép kích thước. Lớp đá, hướng nước và tải trọng của hai công trình khác nhau. Ghi chú nhắc người đọc hỏi viên đá từng làm việc ở đâu trước khi đưa nó vào một bản vẽ mới.

Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note —Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note — a useful example can still be the wrong size

The Cinderwell step demonstrates a clean way to cut a drainage lip, but Pella notices that its underside would concentrate weight on Greenwake's softer soil. Tomas shows her the chisel angle without recommending the same block dimensions. They sketch the cutting line separately from the garden wall plan so a later mason can borrow the craft detail and leave the load estimate open. The step's dark lower edge records repeated wetting at its own site; it does not show how water moves through the Greenwake footing. Pella labels the drawing “method reference.” A good example can transfer a technique while the structure around it still needs its own measurements.

entries.title: Rêu thử trong một luống
entries.body:
Brineglass Moss được trồng trong plot của Lower Cistern, nơi có bóng râm và dòng nước chậm. Rowan thu hoạch một lượng nhỏ sau chu kỳ trồng; Pella dùng phần đó làm phụ gia cho mẻ keo. Vật liệu cho phép cô quan sát cách hỗn hợp bám trên viên đối chứng. Nó không chứng minh loại rêu này mọc tự nhiên trên tường Greenwake, cũng không chứng nhận nước cống sạch. Nhãn mẫu giữ rõ nguồn trồng để không biến thử nghiệm chế tạo thành bản đồ sinh thái.

Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note —Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note — return the remaining moss to its plot

After the resin trial, Mara carries the unused Brineglass Moss back to the Lower Cistern gardener who tended it. The gardener asks for the plot number to stay on the tag because another bed was planted later with a different watering rhythm. Rowan weighs the returned clump and writes down what the trial consumed. Pella had first planned to list the moss as a wall repair ingredient; she changes the page to call it a small experimental additive. The distinction keeps future builders from assuming there is a steady supply. The material came from one cultivated plot and can be requested again only if its grower agrees and the crop allows it.

entries.title: Sơ đồ có mặt sau
entries.body:
Tờ sơ đồ từng được dùng để chỉ hướng nước trong Lower Cistern. Mặt sau ghi hai khoảng giờ và một lần gạch sửa; đơn vị đo không còn ở đầu trang. Pella nhận ra nét đục trên lề giống dấu của xưởng nhà cô, nhưng không thể xác định ai đã ghi nếu thiếu sổ đối chiếu. Ghi chú hữu ích cho việc lần theo lịch vận hành địa phương, không nối áp lực Cinderwell với bức tường ở Greenwake. Rowan chụp lại cả hai mặt trong sổ và ghi thứ tự mà họ tìm thấy tờ giấy.

Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note —Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note — support the paper before opening it flat

The survey sheet tears at one fold when the corner is pressed against the table. Lyra places a thin backing beneath the page and records which fold was already split before they handle it. Pella holds a light at an angle so the marks on the reverse can be read without rubbing the graphite. They make one tracing and store the original between boards with its front and back identified. No one adds a unit to the old measurements based on what the modern channel uses. The paper can guide a search for a related ledger, while its exact instrument and author remain uncertain. Careful handling preserves questions as well as marks.

entries.title: Farwake Carp và lọ dầu thử
entries.body:
Một Farwake Carp được câu tại Celestial Pool vào ngày Rowan mang dụng cụ tới. Cá cung cấp một ít dầu để Pella bôi lên bản lề mẫu; phép thử không dùng trực tiếp trên tường và không thay khảo sát chất lượng nước. Chỉ một lần câu không thể ước tính số cá, mùa sinh sản hay lượng dầu mà cộng đồng có thể lấy bền vững. Nhãn lọ ghi rõ hồ, ngày và mục đích thử để không nhầm nó với vật liệu được phê duyệt cho toàn vùng.

Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note —Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note — the jar has a keeper and an end date

The oil sample stays in a stoppered jar on a shaded shelf, away from the food prep bench. Mara writes the catch location on one side of its card; Pella writes the resin batch number on the other. They agree on a date to discard the remainder unless a second test is planned before then. Rowan records the fish used for the sample as an ingredient in the trial, not as a promise that another catch will be available. The carp was taken with bait and returned through the ordinary kitchen route before its oil was separated. Any future collection must follow the fishing spot's own rules. A wall fitting does not create a right to harvest from the lake.

entries.title: Evelyn yêu cầu đủ điều kiện đo
entries.body:
Evelyn phát hiện hai số nhiệt Pella mang tới được lấy bằng cùng một nhiệt kế nhưng ở hai bề mặt khác nhau. Một mẫu nằm dưới mái, mẫu kia phơi nắng; thời điểm đọc cũng lệch hơn một giờ. Thiết bị giống nhau không bù được điều kiện khác nhau. Evelyn đề nghị đo lại theo cặp ở cùng khoảng giờ và ghi vùng bóng râm, không hiệu chỉnh hai số cũ để chúng trông đồng nhất. Số đo nhiệt có thể giải thích cách lớp thử khô; nó chưa cho biết chu kỳ nóng-lạnh của toàn Greenwake.

Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note —Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note — let the instruments share the same shade

For the paired reading, Evelyn moves both stones beneath the same awning and lets the thermometer settle before either value is written. Rowan reads first; Pella repeats without seeing his number. Their results differ by a small amount, so Evelyn records both and checks the instrument against its reference mark. She does not alter the earlier sunlit reading. A paired trial may explain how heat affects the drying sample under the awning, but it cannot convert every previous observation into a controlled experiment. The wall's season-long behavior still needs checks at other times. Evelyn leaves the setup diagram with the tool box so whoever takes the next shift can repeat the placement.

entries.title: Phiếu sửa dừng giữa hai ca
entries.body:
Phiếu sửa có số lượng đá thay thế, loại vữa và vị trí xếp từng hàng. Dòng cuối chừa trống tên người nhận ca; không còn mực ở mặt sau hay dấu phụ cho biết người thợ đã tiếp tục ở trang khác. Pella nhớ cha mình giao bản vẽ cho đội Greenwake, nhưng ký ức ấy không xác nhận liệu người nhận có nhìn thấy tờ phiếu này. Cô để trống ô bàn giao trong bản phục dựng và thêm nơi để người tiếp quản ghi tên theo lựa chọn của họ, thay vì điền một phỏng đoán vào sổ cũ.

Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note —Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note — a blank handoff is a task, not a name to guess

Pella unfolds the work order under the original seal and uses a loose paper guard where the lower edge has worn thin. The repair quantities are legible, but a dark patch covers part of the receiving-shift line. She remembers carrying timber for her father and cannot say who signed the paper after she left. Rowan makes a new handoff sheet that starts with today's date and a clean receiver field. The historical blank remains unchanged. The crew can document who holds the current key and the next inspection without assigning that responsibility to an unknown worker from the past.

entries.title: Hai luống, hai lần tưới
entries.body:
Lứa thứ hai được trồng phía trong luống và nhận nước vào một lượt khác với vụ đầu. Cả hai dùng hạt từ cùng một gói, nhưng không cùng vị trí hay lịch tưới. Mara khuyên giữ lại cả hai kết quả, kể cả khi một nhánh phát triển chậm hơn. Nếu chỉ lưu cây lớn nhất, bản ghi sẽ che mất chính điều kiện cần biết khi so rễ với móng tường. Rowan ghi riêng ngày gieo, vị trí và thời điểm tưới rồi không tính trung bình hai luống thành một phép đo.

Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note —Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note — give the slower row its full place in the book

The inner bed grows more slowly, and one stalk bends where a watering can brushed it. Mara wants the damaged stalk kept in the harvest count but marked as damaged, so the garden can see both what grew and what handling changed. Pella leaves the row tag in place until the next visit instead of moving it beside the more vigorous plants. The seed came from the same packet as the east bed, but soil depth, light and access were different. These paired beds can help plan a new local trial. They cannot tell the crew which condition caused the wall to move, because they were not measuring the wall under matched conditions.

entries.title: Khoảng lệch giữ bên cạnh mẫu
entries.body:
Hai điểm đo rễ cho kết quả khác nhau dù chúng đến từ cùng một gói hạt. Luống phía trong có bóng râm lâu hơn và nhận nước muộn hơn; vì thế độ lệch không thể quy cho vị trí đơn lẻ. Rowan ghi khoảng thay vì một giá trị trung bình, để người dựng khớp không lấy con số giữa làm chuẩn cứng. Lần đo sau cần giữ dụng cụ, giờ tưới hoặc vùng sáng ổn định nếu muốn tách các yếu tố. Pella đánh dấu những điều kiện còn thay đổi bằng ký hiệu mở, không xóa chúng khỏi bản đồ.

Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note —Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note — mark where the ruler could not lie flat

At the inner bed, a small stone pushes the ruler away from the root by the width of a nail. Rowan adds a dotted offset line showing where the tool rested. Pella repeats the reading from the opposite side and gets a slightly different range. They keep both ranges on the page and place the tool in a labeled wrap so its worn edge can be checked later. Mara says the useful question for the next visit is whether the same visible root has changed, not whether this one measurement matches an expected number. The wall fitting uses its own mechanical marks. A plant measurement should not quietly become the threshold for moving masonry.

entries.title: Mẻ nhựa thử có thể gỡ
entries.body:
Mẻ nhựa dùng sợi nâu lấy ở khe Greenwake, một phần Glassplum và Brineglass Moss trồng tại Lower Cistern. Mara nấu mẻ nhỏ ở Still House rồi để nguội trên viên đá đối chứng. Công thức được chọn vì bám đủ lâu cho phép so các khớp, nhưng chưa được thử qua mùa mưa hoặc tải trọng lớn. Rowan ghi lượng từng thành phần và giữ một mảnh đá chưa phủ làm đối chứng. Nhựa không được dùng để trám nguồn nước, dán đá chịu lực hay thay vữa của toàn bức tường.

Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note —Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note — clean the pan before changing the recipe

Mara washes the Still House pan twice and lets it dry before she weighs the next resin batch. A dark trace from the first mixture stays in the corner, so she records the second batch as a continuation with possible carryover rather than a fresh independent test. Pella asks for a new pan if the workshop can spare one. The crew has enough material for the existing sample, not for a larger wall repair. They keep the uncoated control stone under the same roof and put a date beside both pieces. Before any broader use, a mason must test the mixture against the wall's load, weather and removal needs. This recipe is only a bench trial.

entries.title: Hai phương án cho tường rễ
entries.body:
Pella chuẩn bị hai mẫu từ cùng một viên đá và cùng mẻ nhựa. Khớp bản lề giữ một khoảng thở để rễ lớn thêm; miếng chêm rời chịu một phần áp lực và có thể thay ở lần bảo trì sau. Cả hai đều cần người kiểm tra, nhưng theo lịch khác nhau. Mẫu bàn thử không tái hiện mưa lớn, chuyển động đất hay toàn bộ chiều dài bức tường. Pella quyết định để người làm vườn chọn phương án kèm trách nhiệm bảo trì, đồng thời ghi rõ điều gì vẫn chưa được thử.

Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note —Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note — ask who can realistically inspect each option

At the garden table, Mara explains that a hinge needs someone to check its gap, while the removable slot needs someone to find and use the service key. A volunteer who lives far from the wall asks whether a missed week would make the slot unsafe. Pella adds a line for the inspection interval and names no one until the caretakers choose their shifts. The crew chooses with those duties visible, rather than comparing the two samples as if they were maintenance-free. A branch of the decision belongs to the people who will tend the wall. The record captures their selected method and leaves room to change it if the schedule proves unworkable.

entries.title: Khớp bản lề Greenwake
entries.body:
Khớp mới giữ hai viên đá cách nhau một khoảng nhỏ, đủ để nhánh rễ còn lại không bị ép vào mép sắc. Nhựa thử được dùng hết trong lớp lót; sau khi khô, khớp vẫn có thể tháo khi cần kiểm tra. Pella đánh dấu điểm gắn bằng vạch đồng để người làm vườn tìm được mà không phải bới đất quanh rễ. Lắp xong không chứng minh tường chịu được mọi cơn mưa. Nó tạo một chỗ quan sát có thể mở lại mà không phá toàn bộ hàng đá.

Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note —Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note — the hinge's first mark belongs to this morning

Before fitting the hinge, Pella scratches one copper reference line across the two stones and draws a matching line on the plan. After installation, Rowan checks whether the marks still align, then photographs the gap with a scale in view. The copper shows the position on this day; it is not a forecast of where the stones should remain. Mara keeps the fitting key in a labeled box that can be reached without disturbing the bed. If the seam needs to be opened, the gardener can request the key and record why. The reversible joint makes inspection easier. It does not make an unfinished wall safe for every use.

entries.title: Ba điểm ở khớp thở
entries.body:
Sau khi nhựa se, khoảng hở rộng nhất nằm gần đỉnh khớp, nơi ít đất đỡ nhất. Hai điểm thấp hơn vẫn đo được nhưng có sai số vì bề mặt đá sần. Rowan vẽ ba dấu mốc lên phiếu theo thứ tự từ trên xuống. Nếu lần sau dùng điểm khác, chuỗi so sánh sẽ mất ý nghĩa. Pella không lấp phần rộng nhất chỉ để đường đo trông đều; độ không đều có thể là phản ứng của vật liệu với viên đá hiện tại.

Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note —Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note — record the side from which each point was read

Rowan approaches the upper gap from the path, while Pella reads the two lower points from inside the garden. The rough stone edge catches the ruler differently from either side. They repeat the measurements after exchanging positions and mark the reader beside each result. The readings converge at the middle but not at the top. Pella leaves the upper range visible and asks that future checks use the same approach where possible. A different reading angle may explain part of the difference. The crew will not pack the gap merely to make the three figures agree; preserving the mismatch helps the next inspection decide whether it is a surface issue or a change in the joint.

entries.title: Lá sau lượt tưới
entries.body:
Glassplum gần khớp vẫn đứng sau một lượt tưới. Lá phía tường đậm màu hơn lá phía trong, nhưng chúng còn khác nhau về ánh sáng buổi sáng. Mara ghi vị trí từng cụm lá và ngày lấy mẫu. Quan sát chỉ kéo dài trong một lượt tưới; rễ có thể phản ứng chậm hơn phần thân nhìn thấy. Pella giữ lịch kiểm tra khớp độc lập với lịch chăm cây để người đọc không nhầm sức sống của luống với độ bền của công trình.

Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note —Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note — a leaf can show exposure without showing a cause

At dawn, the wall-facing leaves stay in shade longer than those at the inner edge. By midday the shadow has moved, and the two samples look closer in color. Mara marks both observation times instead of using the first difference to label one plant unhealthy. She asks the gardener to keep the same two tags for another week and to water from the established can marks. Pella's wall check remains on a separate card, since leaf color does not measure stone movement. If the roots are to be compared later, the team will need to note the soil and light as well as the visible growth. The garden remains a living place, not a static gauge.

entries.title: Rễ đang sống và phần đã cắt
entries.body:
Mara tách phần rễ còn sống cạnh khớp khỏi đoạn đã cắt để lấy mẫu. Hai phần có thể khác nhau về độ ẩm và độ đàn hồi; gộp chúng sẽ làm mất điều kiện của từng mẫu. Cô quyết định không buộc nhánh non vào tường để tránh ép cây đi theo hình muốn có của con người. Pella bổ sung ngày tái kiểm tra sau lượt chăm tiếp theo. Lịch này là lời nhắc kiểm tra, không phải giả định rằng cây sẽ giữ nguyên hướng đến lúc đó.

Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note —Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note — do not tie the new root to the old repair

The young root curves toward a damp patch below the hinge. Mara refuses to tie it to the copper mark, even temporarily, because the tie could steer the growth and make the next survey answer a question the gardeners created. She places a loose marker in the soil instead, far enough away that rain will not drive it into the root. Pella schedules another look after the next pruning, when the gardener can see the root without lifting the stones. The clipped sample remains labeled separately from the living branch. Both can teach them something, but only one is still responding to the bed as it grows.

entries.title: Một lần tưới trên hai phiến đá
entries.body:
Hai phiến được tưới từ cùng một gáo nước. Phiến có khớp bản lề giữ ít bùn hơn ở cạnh dưới trong lần thử, nhưng độ dốc và vị trí đặt chưa đồng nhất. Rowan không gọi đây là khả năng thoát nước của cả bức tường. Pella đánh dấu hướng dòng và đề xuất đảo vị trí hai phiến ở lần thử kế tiếp. Nếu kết quả đổi theo chỗ đặt, độ dốc có thể giải thích nhiều hơn loại khớp.

Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note —Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note — swap the trays before naming the better slope

The first run-off test put the hinged stone on the lower side of the board. Pella swaps the two stone trays and repeats the same pour from a marked height. This time the unhinged piece sheds less mud. Rowan records the reversed result, then checks that the board did not rock during the second pour. The test suggests the tray position mattered; it says little about a wall anchored in living soil. Mara asks them to repeat with both orientations on another day before the comparison is used in a meeting. The fitting can still be inspected for mud retention, but no single pour establishes drainage performance across Greenwake.

entries.title: Bùn thử không phải mẫu nước
entries.body:
Talia chỉ nhận phần bùn đã được thu riêng trên phiến thử. Cô ghi nó là vật liệu bám, không gán cho nước trong basin. Khay được tráng riêng để không mang cặn vào các phép đo khác. Mẫu này có thể giúp so độ bám dưới cùng thao tác tưới; nó không cho biết chất gì hòa tan trong nước hay có an toàn để uống hay không. Pella chấp nhận giới hạn ấy và sửa nhãn ở bản vẽ, vốn trước đó chỉ ghi 'nước bẩn'.

Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note —Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note — label what the rinse has touched

Talia writes the order of contact on the sample jar: test stone, collection tray, rinse vessel. The tray had been used earlier for a garden sample, so she moves the sediment to a second container labeled “possible carryover.” Pella asks if they can still use the first jar; Talia says it is suitable for comparing visible particles, not for claiming where every grain began. She does not test the basin water from this material. The working card now says “sediment from a bench rinse” rather than “water residue.” A smaller claim gives the crew a reliable way to repeat the adhesion test without attaching an unsupported water conclusion to it.

entries.title: Lịch kiểm tra có thể sửa
entries.body:
Lịch được treo dưới mái để nước không làm nhòe mực. Pella ghi lần kiểm tra đầu, dấu mốc khớp và một điều kiện kích hoạt lần xem tiếp theo: nếu rễ đổi hướng hoặc đất xói sau mưa, người chăm cần quay lại sớm hơn. Không có ngày cố định nào đại diện cho mọi kiểu thời tiết. Ô để sửa được giữ rộng hơn cột ngày, nhắc người sau rằng lịch là công cụ của khu vườn chứ không phải mệnh lệnh không thể đổi.

Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note —Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note — make the early check possible to request

Mara adds a box to the schedule for an unscheduled visit after heavy rain or fresh soil loss. She does not define “heavy” by a single number because the hillside drains differently after the garden paths are cleared. Instead, the caretakers can write what they saw and ask for Pella or a mason to look sooner. The next routine date remains on the page, but it can move if no one is available. Pella keeps the box wide enough to include a reason and the person who accepted the request. A flexible review is only useful if someone can call for it and the record shows whether the request reached a worker.

entries.title: Bản ghi của khớp bản lề
entries.body:
Pella sửa phiếu cũ bằng một ghi chú mới, không xóa dòng phán đoán ban đầu. Bản sửa nêu khoảng cách khớp, mẫu cây cạnh tường, một lượt tưới và giới hạn của phiến đá đối chứng. Mara nhận việc quan sát rễ trong lịch làm vườn; người sửa tường giữ khóa tháo khớp. Nếu hai người không thể tới cùng ngày, sổ vẫn có chỗ ghi ai đã kiểm tra phần nào. Kết quả là một phương án bảo trì có thể sửa, không phải lời hứa rằng tường sẽ không nứt nữa.

Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note —Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note — a report can separate observation from repair approval

The first copy describes the gap and living roots but leaves the work order unsigned. Pella makes a second page for the mason to approve any change to the load-bearing stones. Mara can confirm garden conditions without being asked to certify construction. Rowan labels the two pages “field observation” and “repair authorization” and ties them with a removable thread. If a later shift sees a new crack, they can amend the observation without silently rewriting the approval. The wall has a chosen maintenance plan and a named key holder; it has not received an inspection of every stretch. Pella wants the next crew to know exactly which page they are allowed to change.

entries.title: Miếng chêm rời Greenwake
entries.body:
Miếng chêm được giữ trong một rãnh mở, không bị trám kín với lớp vữa cũ. Pella muốn người làm vườn nhìn thấy vạch đo và rút chêm ra khi khoảng rễ thay đổi. Nhựa thử giữ miếng chêm khỏi trượt trong lần kiểm tra, nhưng không được xem là lớp chống nước. Một người có thể tháo nó bằng dụng cụ thường mà không phải phá hàng đá. Cách lắp này đòi hỏi lịch kiểm tra đều hơn phương án bản lề; nếu lịch bị bỏ quên, khe có thể khép mà không ai nhận ra.

Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note —Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note — keep the key within the garden's reach

The removable wedge works only if the service tool can be found before the gap closes. Mara asks to keep the key box beneath the covered bench, not in the distant workshop where a caretaker might need to cross a flooded path. Pella checks that the box is reachable from a seated position and adds a large mark to its lid. The tool's location is written on the garden map and the shift board. A person can still decline the service task or pass it to another caretaker. Making the fitting removable is a design property; making its upkeep accessible requires a separate, revisable arrangement.

entries.title: Mốc thay không phải cỡ cây
entries.body:
Ba vạch nằm trên miếng chêm: hai vạch biên là giới hạn cơ học của mẫu thử, còn vạch giữa là vị trí lúc lắp. Pella không dùng vạch biên làm ngưỡng sinh trưởng vì chúng được chọn theo dụng cụ, không theo rễ. Người chăm cây sẽ so mốc giữa với rễ lộ ra mỗi lần dọn đất, rồi ghi lý do nếu thay sớm. Phiếu hiện chưa có số liệu của cả một mùa, nên vạch vẫn chỉ dẫn cho lần xem tiếp theo.

Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note —Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note — explain the tick marks to the next gardener

Mara asks Rowan to demonstrate the center mark without using the words “good” or “bad.” He points to the position where the wedge sat during installation and reads the number from the ruler. Pella adds a small sketch showing how to hold the tool so a new caretaker does not measure from the rounded edge. The two outer ticks still describe the sample's mechanical travel, not a safe growth limit. A caretaker who sees the marker near either edge should request a review rather than push the wedge back by force. The instruction is short enough to post beside the fitting and leaves the final decision with the trained repairer.

entries.title: Hai chu kỳ không tự tạo thành một nguyên nhân
entries.body:
Owen đặt bản lịch gió cạnh phiếu tăng trưởng của Glassplum. Một bản dùng lần quan sát trời đêm; bản kia dựa trên lượt tưới và thu hoạch. Chúng có thể giúp sắp xếp chuyến kiểm tra để người đo tới đúng thời điểm, nhưng không chứng minh tín hiệu sao điều khiển rễ cây. Owen không đồng ý dùng đường kẻ nối hai cột ngày khi chưa có giả thuyết kiểm tra được. Pella thêm nhãn đơn vị và giữ lịch rễ độc lập với lịch trời.

Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note —Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note — keep the sky calendar out of the repair trigger

Owen notices that the planting notes and his wind calendar both turn a page near the same new moon. He could connect their marks with a thin line, but first asks Pella what observation that line would predict. They have no paired series long enough to test whether a sky event changes the root gap. He instead clips the two calendars side by side under separate headings, with their units and observers named. A gardener can still use the wind sheet to choose a sheltered time for work. It does not determine when the wedge should be moved. That trigger remains tied to the visible root and the measured stone gap.

entries.title: Lần câu lặp lại
entries.body:
Rowan câu thêm một Farwake Carp ở cùng Celestial Pool để lặp quy trình lấy dầu. Mẫu được lưu trong lọ riêng, dù vị trí và mồi giống lần trước. Hai lượt bắt không đủ để ước lượng đàn cá; chúng chỉ cho thấy thao tác có thể lặp lại trong thời gian ngắn. Pella cần một bản lề mẫu khác nếu muốn biết dầu có đổi ma sát giữa các miếng chêm. Ngày lưu, nhiệt độ nơi cất và dụng cụ lấy dầu được ghi ở cả hai nhãn.

Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note —Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note — two samples still share one lake

The second Farwake Carp goes into its own jar with a new label and a clean tool. The first jar is still sealed nearby, but the two oils are not pooled. Pella applies each to separate small hinge pins and lets both rest under the same roof. One turns more easily at first; after an hour, the difference is smaller. Rowan writes the elapsed time rather than calling either oil the better choice. Two catches can show that the preparation is repeatable enough for another bench check. They do not show how often carp can be caught or whether the oil will behave the same in wet stone, winter air or a load-bearing joint.

entries.title: Lịch bảo trì dựa trên quan sát
entries.body:
Lịch mới đặt hai ô cạnh nhau: vị trí rễ nhìn thấy và độ rộng khe đá. Người bảo trì chỉ rút miếng chêm khi một trong hai mốc vượt ngưỡng đã ghi trong bản thử, rồi phải ghi lại ai đã xem. Ngày trên lịch là lời nhắc quay lại, không phải lệnh thay tự động. Pella để trống cột kết quả sau thay để đội vườn có thể kiểm tra liệu thao tác đó có làm khe rộng hơn. Cấu trúc lịch không chứng minh ngưỡng hiện tại đã đúng cho mọi cây.

Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note —Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note — a missed visit should produce a new date

The week marked for the first wedge check passes while Mara is away caring for the upper beds. No one moves the fitting. When she returns, she records the missed visit and chooses the next available afternoon with Pella, rather than drawing a false checkmark in the old square. Rowan adds a place to note which observations were made after the gap in the schedule. The wall may have changed during that time; the page cannot say whether it did. The calendar now makes a missed shift visible and allows the caretakers to reschedule. A maintenance plan should help people resume the work without pretending they were there.

entries.title: Mẫu rêu thứ hai
entries.body:
Lứa rêu thứ hai được trồng sau khi mẻ đầu đã nấu, với ngày gieo mới và một phần đất khác trong plot. Rowan tách nó khỏi mẫu cũ để biết vật liệu nào đi vào phép thử rãnh chêm. Cả hai lứa vẫn đến từ cùng một Lower Cistern plot, nên không đại diện cho mọi vùng có Brineglass Moss. Mẫu mới giúp chuẩn bị lớp lót dự phòng; nó không chứng minh cấu trúc sẽ bền nếu rêu không được cung cấp ở mùa sau.

Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note —Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note — count the plot before requesting another batch

The Lower Cistern gardener asks the repair crew to bring back an empty sack with the moss tag still tied to it. That lets them see how much was used and whether the requested amount matched the trial. Rowan records the amount returned, the amount left in the plot and the next harvest date supplied by the gardener. Pella changes the materials list from “available” to “grown under agreement.” The distinction matters if another repair crew arrives during a slow season. They may need a different fitting or a later date. The wall plan should not silently turn someone else's crop into a guaranteed supply.

entries.title: Chìa khóa được bàn giao
entries.body:
Hộp dụng cụ có cờ lê rút chêm và thước đo khớp. Trước đây chìa được treo ở cửa mà không có sổ, nên Mara không thể biết dụng cụ đang ở đâu khi cần kiểm tra gấp. Bản mới thêm ô giờ mượn, giờ trả và một dòng cho người kế tiếp chỉnh lịch. Họ có thể từ chối ca hoặc chuyển chìa cho người khác. Hộp không tạo ra người bảo trì tự động; nó chỉ làm rõ trách nhiệm đang nằm ở đâu khi một người không thể tiếp tục.

Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note —Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note — record a return even when no repair was needed

At dusk, Tomas signs out the box and walks the path with Mara, who knows where the lower step holds rain. They inspect the wedge, find no reason to adjust it and return the tools before the gate closes. The service card records “checked, unchanged” with both the outgoing and returning times. Pella says the no-change visit matters: otherwise a later reader cannot tell whether the wedge was inspected or simply forgotten. The key box remains available to the next shift and the caretakers can decline future visits if the route is unsafe. A blank service page is not proof that nothing needed attention.

entries.title: Bản ghi miếng chêm theo mùa
entries.body:
Pella cập nhật bản vẽ bằng vị trí rãnh, mốc đo và quy trình bàn giao chìa hộp dụng cụ. Người làm vườn giữ quyền thay lịch khi mưa đến sớm hoặc không có ai trực; người xây tường ghi nguyên nhân mỗi lần rút chêm. Bản ghi vẫn giữ dòng cũ về đá hỏng để người đọc thấy vì sao đội sửa đã chọn cách lắp trước đây. Phương án mới không bảo đảm khớp luôn an toàn. Nó giúp người sau nhận ra lúc nào cần kiểm tra và có thể sửa hướng dẫn mà không xóa lịch sử.

Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note —Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note — keep a copy where the caretaker works

Pella makes one small map for the garden bench and one full drawing for the repair archive. The bench copy includes the wedge position, service box and request path, but leaves out the family details in the older work order. Mara asks that a damp-weather note be added by hand if the path changes again. Rowan numbers both copies and writes where the other one is kept. If a correction is made to either, the caretaker can ask for both to be updated without handing over the original record. The report now travels with the tool people need, while the longer history remains available to anyone responsible for the wall.

entries.title: Sổ tường Greenwake có dòng dành cho người sau
entries.body:
Bản cuối giữ cả dòng kết luận cũ lẫn phương án được chọn. Pella ghi tên người chịu trách nhiệm xem khớp, vị trí bản nhựa dự phòng và nơi đặt dụng cụ. Cô không điền sẵn ngày cho nhiều mùa tiếp theo; người chăm vườn sẽ bổ sung sau khi quan sát cây. Bức tường đã được gia cố theo một mẫu nhỏ, còn các đoạn khác vẫn cần kiểm tra riêng. Sổ đóng lại bằng một ô mở dành cho sai số hoặc cách sửa mới, để công trình không phụ thuộc vào việc người kế tiếp phải coi bản vẽ cũ là hoàn hảo.

Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note —Supplemental Greenwake rootwall note — leave the next inspection's author line empty

Pella closes the binder after adding the repair plan, but leaves the next inspector's line untouched. Mara says she can take the first visit; she does not promise every visit after it. The current key holder is named on the shift board and can pass the task along when needed. A spare resin sample is stored with its recipe and discard date, not sealed into the wall as if it could never change. Beyond this repaired stretch, the garden still has stones that have not been measured. The final page gives a new crew the map, tool location and right to revise the method. It does not require them to repeat Pella's choice if the conditions differ.

entries.title: Silas Returns to the Hunter's Map
entries.body:
After Nella files a rule for future witnesses, Silas brings his own account to the Salt Road map. He does not ask Rowan to decide whether the arrow changed the caravan's course. The map contains no view of every bend, and the people on the road were making decisions under pressure. Silas begins with what he can own: he fired, he chose the marked shaft, and he was standing at the western notch. Everything beyond those facts needs another source.

Supplemental arrow archive note — the fold that will not close

Nella's return slip was clipped to the lower edge of the map, not placed over the empty bend. Silas notices that the map was folded through the western notch for years; each crease carries dust from a different shelf. He and Rowan flatten it under two clean weights, then leave the old fold visible instead of pressing it away. A new drawing can make the road easier to read, but it cannot repair a missing viewpoint by making the paper look continuous.

Silas asks that his own account be kept beside the map without being used as its caption. A reader may compare the two sources, but the map is not proof of the remembered flash and the memory is not a key for every mark on the road. The folder's contents list names each object on its own line.

entries.title: Three Positions on One Fold
entries.body:
The old paper joins three places with a single red stroke: the notch where a signal could be loosed, the crest where a rider might first see it, and the bend hidden behind pale stone. A drawn stroke can suggest a path, but it cannot prove an uninterrupted view. Rowan adds a small index beside each place instead of extending the line through the blind bend.

Supplemental arrow archive note — a route line is a proposal

Rowan adds three numbered circles and a fourth mark for the section no one can see from either road approach. The circles record where a person stood; they do not imply that the person moved from one to another. Silas had first drawn an arrowhead along the red stroke, which made the line look like a travel direction. He removes it after Rowan asks which source supports the direction rather than the locations.

The replacement legend uses an open bracket for a surveyed edge and a dotted edge for an unobserved interval. Future mapmakers can extend the survey by adding a dated layer. They should not erase the bracket simply because a later observer gets a longer view from different weather or a different height.

entries.title: Windglass Reed Field Bundle
entries.body:
The salt-bed plot yields two stems from a single cut. Both were grown in the same furrow, but one leaned toward the road and one toward the sea before harvest. Silas asks Rowan to preserve the cut end and note the afternoon gust. The reed can be a reference for a fletching trial; it is not a substitute for recording the bow angle or the weather at the time of a shot.

Supplemental arrow archive note — the cut belongs to the sample

Rowan ties a loose paper tag to each stem rather than carving a mark into the reed. The tag records the furrow, date cut, direction of lean and whether the stem came from the road-facing or sea-facing side. Silas asks Tomas to keep the sample intact until another fletcher can inspect the grain. Removing the bark now would change the surface they are trying to compare.

The bundle is stored away from the test bow so a future reader will not assume it was the shaft material. It can help describe local plant variation or a possible fletching source. No surviving arrow is attached to it, and the archive does not state that either stem resembles the one Silas used years ago.

entries.title: A Saltspool Skate Scale
entries.body:
A single Saltspool Skate scale scatters a narrow band of light when held wet beside the pool. The sample changes as it dries and turns in the hand. Rowan records the catch location, bait and time before passing it to Silas. The scale may help compare reflective surfaces in a controlled test, but it cannot recreate the arrow's brightness after years of dust, weather and altered memory.

Supplemental arrow archive note — brightness needs conditions

Lyra puts the scale on a dark cloth and then on pale stone. The reflection looks broader against the cloth; the sample is unchanged, but the background is not. She records the surface, angle, dampness and observer position beside Rowan's drawing. Silas watches from the road and sees a different glint from the one he sees at the table.

They keep the two observations because disagreement can reveal which conditions matter. Neither is a reconstruction of the old signal. The sample came from a fish caught now, and the scale's sheen changes as it dries. A later experiment can compare present materials under named conditions without assigning this scale to an arrow that no one recovered.

entries.title: The Sentinel's Filament
entries.body:
The Roadglass Sentinel has nested in the range rubble and dragged bright filament into its den. Rowan clears the path while Silas keeps beyond the marked test area. The recovered filament is a useful binding sample. Its position after the fight says where the creature carried it, not where the old arrow flew, so the field note keeps those observations on different pages.

Supplemental arrow archive note — a recovered strand has a short history

The filament is collected only after Rowan marks the Sentinel's den and Silas records that he did not enter it. A clean paper sleeve keeps the strand from catching on the map case. The label states who removed it, where it lay after the fight and which parts of the den were disturbed during the encounter. That is enough to preserve a useful binding sample without pretending the creature left it there on the night of the old signal.

Tomas uses a short offcut for a repair demonstration and returns the unused length to the sleeve. The remaining sample shows how the thread behaves under present tension. Its strength may inform a craft choice; its color cannot identify an old shaft.

entries.title: The Windline Charm
entries.body:
Tomas Reed makes a small adjustable loop that fixes a sightline to a repeatable notch. Windglass Reed forms its backing, the skate scale provides a bright edge for comparison, and Roadglass Filament holds the two parts without hiding their join. The tool helps reproduce one setup. Silas writes that it does not make the user a better witness and cannot tell whether anyone saw an arrow on a different night.

Supplemental arrow archive note — calibration is not testimony

Tomas stamps the gauge's maker mark on the inside edge, where it can be checked without hiding the adjustable notch. Rowan records the starting position and the amount of movement before the loop settles. They repeat the reset three times, once with Silas watching and twice with him turned away, to see whether expectation changes the reading. It does not turn the tool into a witness; it makes one part of a present-day comparison repeatable.

Silas keeps the charm because it reminds him how carefully a setup must be described. He refuses to call it an arrow finder. It cannot locate a missing shaft or infer what a traveler saw from a distant road.

entries.title: The Crest's Blind Edge
entries.body:
The crest hides the lower mile from a person standing at the road. A second person two paces north sees farther between the rocks. The difference is small on the map and large enough to change an account of what was visible. Rowan marks both standing places and asks that any future witness give their position before describing the road.

Supplemental arrow archive note — a standing place is part of a view

Rowan writes the eye height beside each crest mark and uses the same shoulder-width stance on both visits. A short person sees more of the lower road from the northern position because the rock shelf blocks less of the line, while a taller observer at the southern mark catches a strip of sky instead. The variation is not a flaw to average away; it describes why a witness's position belongs with the claim.

Silas adds the place where he remembers standing but leaves its exact distance from the old milestone uncertain. The account can be revisited if another person recognizes the ground. Until then, the archive preserves a remembered position separately from Rowan's current measurements.

entries.title: Two Ends of the Same Bend
entries.body:
The north approach hides the exit of the bend; the south approach hides a cart-sized space behind the salt shelf. Walking to both ends reveals no single position from which the whole curve is visible. Silas puts his remembered flash on a separate tracing instead of forcing it through the obscured section. The road's shape leaves room for several decisions without identifying which one any traveler made.

Supplemental arrow archive note — movement changes the question

Walking the bend makes the hidden space change shape. From the north, the salt shelf covers a loaded cart; from the south, a person can see the wheel tracks but not the road beyond the pale stone. A moving rider might pass through both views, but the route does not show when the rider arrived or what they noticed. Rowan draws each view as a small frame instead of merging them into one panorama.

Silas looks at the frames and says the old account had made the bend sound like a single window. He revises the description to name where his sight stopped. That correction narrows his claim without removing the fact that he chose to fire.

entries.title: Marks Without a Date
entries.body:
The stone contains three shallow horizontal cuts, one deep groove and a patch of newer mortar. The marks do not share a known date. Silas remembers practicing in the area but cannot identify this particular groove. Rowan measures each scar and labels the age as unknown. A mark is evidence that something touched stone; it is not proof of which person or event left it.

Supplemental arrow archive note — absence of a date is a field value

Rowan assigns temporary labels A through D to the cuts and photographs their edges beside a ruler. The mortar patch crosses the shallowest mark, but there is no dated repair ledger for this stretch of wall. That overlap gives an order between two traces, not a calendar year. Silas keeps his practice memory in a separate column so it cannot silently become a date for mark C.

When the group rechecks the stone after rain, a wet edge looks deeper. The earlier dry measurement remains in the folder; the new value is added with its weather note. The record can grow through comparison without replacing an older observation that was made under different conditions.

entries.title: A Known Shot Is a Better Comparison
entries.body:
Silas fires one unmarked practice shaft at the new target while Rowan observes from the road. They record the shooter, release point, wind direction and time before measuring the impact. This gives them a known example to compare with the old stone. The test does not make the old mark identifiable; it shows which facts a future comparison would need before anyone makes that claim.

Supplemental arrow archive note — the control shot is a control

Before releasing the practice shaft, Rowan places a paper witness card at the target and signs the back. Silas then names his bow, draw length and release point while Tomas checks the wind ribbon. They use a fresh target face so an earlier impact cannot be mistaken for this one. The impact location is measured twice by separate readers before they compare numbers.

The control shot demonstrates how present conditions can be documented. It does not estimate the trajectory of a missing arrow, because the old bow, shaft, wind and release are not available as a matched set. Silas accepts the smaller use of the trial: it can show what a future account should include.

entries.title: A Decision Made at Eighteen
entries.body:
Silas remembers the written order and the dust above the lower mile. He also remembers choosing to fire before he saw the caravan. That choice belongs to him even though the unseen road leaves its effect uncertain. The note does not turn obedience into innocence, and it does not turn an incomplete view into proof that the arrow caused a particular loss.

Supplemental arrow archive note — the moment before release

Silas writes that he heard the command, reached for the marked shaft and made the choice to draw. He cannot tell whether a different choice would have kept the road safe. He can tell that no one put the bow in his hands or released it for him. This distinction gives him a responsibility he can name without pretending to control every consequence that followed.

The page is dated from his present interview, not backdated to the night itself. He reads the statement once aloud and changes a phrase that made the order sound like an excuse. Rowan keeps the first draft with the correction attached so later readers can see how the account was narrowed.

entries.title: An Order Is Not an Outcome
entries.body:
Ruth confirms that the dispatch directed a watcher to signal if the western road became impassable. It contains no count of those who saw the arrow and no instruction that names a particular household. She puts her earlier concealment in the record beside the order. The page can establish what command Silas received; the consequences still need accounts from people who were there.

Supplemental arrow archive note — the dispatch has its own chain

Ruth identifies the dispatch drawer, the docket number and the place where she hid a copy when the inquiry began. She writes the concealment in her own hand, apart from Silas's recollection of the signal. The original is not moved into the public notice folder; Rowan makes a reference card that lets a custodian request it under the same archive rules as the other dispatches.

The order describes a condition for signaling. It does not list every traveler, say who heard a sound or say what happened after the road became difficult to see. Ruth is willing to correct her earlier omission. She does not claim that her new statement fills every gap left by the dispatch.

entries.title: A Witness May Decline the Question
entries.body:
Nella does not give a statement about the arrow's effect. She confirms the returned card and refuses to infer who brought it or where her sibling went. Silas accepts the boundary without asking Rowan to persuade her. A record can include the limits of an interview without turning the refusal into evidence for either explanation.

Supplemental arrow archive note — refusal remains private

Nella asks Rowan not to record why she declines the question. The interview note therefore states only that the question was offered, the witness declined and no further prompt was made. It does not use a mark for “uncooperative,” and the blank space after the entry is left empty rather than filled with the clerk's interpretation.

Silas thanks her without asking for another conversation. He understands that a family can help set the boundaries around its own papers without becoming responsible for finishing his account. If Nella chooses to speak later, her words can be added with their own date and permission. Silence does not become a vote for either side of the arrow's uncertain effect.

entries.title: The Fact Card Before the Choice
entries.body:
The card lists four entries with different sources: Ruth's dispatch, Silas's remembered shot, Rowan's present-day view survey and Nella's choice not to connect the arrow to her sibling. The blank between them is visible rather than filled with a guess. Silas agrees that signing his own action does not give him ownership of another person's account.

Supplemental arrow archive note — four sources, four permissions

The card is printed on thick paper and divided into four columns: dispatch, remembered action, present survey and witness boundary. Ruth may correct the dispatch reference, Silas may revise his account, Rowan may add a dated measurement, and Nella controls whether she contributes anything. No one has permission to edit another column merely because the entries appear together.

The card lists the blank interval as unresolved and carries a revision date. A later source can be attached to the relevant column without changing the rest. Silas signs beside his own action and leaves the space beside Nella's boundary unmarked. The card's layout makes the limits legible before a reader reaches the interpretation.

entries.title: The Record Policy
entries.body:
Silas accepts responsibility for sending the signal arrow and for waiting too long before documenting his own position. The group now has to choose how other people will encounter that account. A public first-person statement can make his action visible without exposing Nella's family. A sealed copy can preserve the same method while giving the family control over whether to review it. Neither route settles the arrow's effect.

Supplemental arrow archive note — policy governs copies

The choice is discussed after Silas's admission has been written in full. The wording of that admission, its date and the description of his limited view travel into either filing route. Only the handling of the named copy changes: one policy places a first-person statement where any passerby can read it; the other gives the family a private copy and publishes the method without names.

Silas says he will not call privacy a way to avoid blame, and Nella says she will not be required to stand beside a board to prove that she was consulted. Their conditions are recorded separately. The policy card leaves room for a later witness to choose another route.

entries.title: A Statement with a Subject
entries.body:
Silas chooses a sentence whose subject is himself. It records his action and the limited view he had at the time. He removes a later phrase that said the caravan turned because of him; nobody present can establish that from the surviving evidence. The correction makes the statement narrower and more accountable at once.

Supplemental arrow archive note — first person keeps its boundary

The final sentence begins with “I fired,” not with “the road turned.” Silas reads the subject and verb together to check that the statement names the action he owns. A separate sentence says the lower mile was outside his view. The removed phrase is retained on a dated draft sheet with a note explaining that the surviving evidence did not support it.

That revision does not soften his responsibility. It prevents an admission about an action from expanding into a claim about every person's response. The public statement is short enough to be read at the board, with a reference to the longer method card for anyone who wants the measurements.

entries.title: A Public Copy Without a Roll Call
entries.body:
The notice board carries Silas's signed account, a small drawing of his standing place and the weather notes. The page contains no list of travelers or households. It says the lower mile was out of sight and asks for corrections from witnesses who choose to speak. The public copy cannot be mistaken for a complete roster because it does not claim to be one.

Supplemental arrow archive note — a notice is not a roll call

Rowan positions the board away from the barracks door so readers do not have to pass a clerk or declare why they stopped. The account includes Silas's name because he chose to sign it, but it omits the names of travelers and households. A small index directs corrections to a box that can be opened without gathering a crowd around the page.

Nella checks the layout and confirms that her family does not appear. She does not endorse the account by checking this boundary. The receipt says only that she inspected the page's scope. The posted notice can be public while keeping the act of reading, commenting or walking away private.

entries.title: A Repeatable Daylight Method
entries.body:
The method sheet records the two standing places, the ridge height, the wind and the daylight conditions. It also labels the current target as a modern practice shot. Tomas checks that the gauge opens to the same notch when reset. Repeating these conditions can compare equipment in daylight; it cannot recreate what a distant traveler saw during the old signal.

Supplemental arrow archive note — the setup travels with the measurement

Each daylight trial has a small card listing the ridge marker, observer height, target surface, wind ribbon and start time. If one condition changes, the new sheet gets a fresh identifier rather than being called a failed repeat. Tomas marks the gauge position in pencil so it can be checked against the tool itself. The method tells another craftsperson how the present comparison was made.

The sheet is deliberately separated from Silas's account. Someone can repeat the sightline test without agreeing with his memory or reading the family copy. A method can be open to correction while personal statements remain under their author's control.

entries.title: Two Signatures Do Not Become One
entries.body:
Ruth reviews the wording and signs a separate note about concealing the dispatch. The two statements share a folder but keep their authors, dates and actions distinct. The archive does not use Ruth's guilt to confirm Silas's memory or Silas's signature to erase Ruth's choice.

Supplemental arrow archive note — adjacent pages remain separate

Ruth dates her note by the day she disclosed the hidden dispatch, not by the night it was issued. She describes when she found the copy, why she kept it and when she returned it to the archive. These facts concern her custody of the order. They do not rewrite the terms of the order or provide a second witness to Silas's release of the arrow.

The binder uses two tabs and a shared index number. A reader can follow the related material without mistaking two signatures for one account. If either person later makes a correction, it attaches to that person's page and leaves the other page unchanged.

entries.title: Review Is Not Consent to Publish
entries.body:
Nella reads the public notice and confirms that it contains no family name. She declines to add a quote. Her review is logged as a check of the page's boundary, not as approval of Silas's account or consent to publish her words. The difference remains written in the receipt.

Supplemental arrow archive note — scope check, not endorsement

Nella points out that an earlier copy used “the families” as if all households had sent a shared request. The board text is changed to say that one relative asked to inspect the page. The correction avoids turning a single person's action into a group position. Nella chooses not to supply a sentence for the public account, and her choice is not printed on the board.

The archive receipt records the narrow edit and the date she reviewed it. It does not contain her reaction, her family history or a statement about Silas. A reader can see that she checked one privacy boundary without learning anything else she did not choose to share.

entries.title: The Uncertainty Has a Signature
entries.body:
Silas signs his first-person account and the unresolved line below it. This does not weaken his admission; it prevents later readers from expanding it into a claim he cannot support. The date and witness to the signature are recorded so a later correction can be attached without quietly replacing his words.

Supplemental arrow archive note — a signature can own a sentence

Silas signs below the account rather than beside the route card. A custodian witnesses the signing and gives him a duplicate that shows the same page number. He can later challenge the wording or add a correction, but neither action silently replaces the first signed copy. The correction pocket records what changed and who requested the change.

The unresolved line is signed too. Silas wants it to be clear that the limit is part of his statement, not an editor's attempt to protect him. A reader may question his memory, but cannot fairly extend his signature to a conclusion the signed page expressly leaves open.

entries.title: A Public Copy with Room to Change
entries.body:
The posted account has a dated correction pocket and a blank line for the next review. No one is required to speak by that date. The original statement remains legible if a correction is added, and the notice explains where a witness may leave a private request instead of a public name.

Supplemental arrow archive note — a correction should not demand a crowd
